multiDeviceAudit.simultaneousLogins: Allowed (Each device receives its own distinct refresh token hash in refresh_tokens table)
multiDeviceAudit.deviceTracking: userSecurityCenter registers deviceId, deviceHash, platform, and IP metadata
multiDeviceAudit.singleDeviceLogout: Revokes only the targeted refresh token / device record
multiDeviceAudit.globalLogout: Revokes all refresh tokens for the user across all devices
